controls.name: data-graph-keeps-graphs-apart
controls.find: { loaded(focus, n) && exists|h: G| #[trigger] prop(r, h, n) }
controls.replace: { loaded(focus, n) && forall|h: G| #[trigger] prop(r, h, n) }
controls.classification: decision: a node must have the property in every graph (a different merge); the masking theorem must notice

controls.name: focus-loads-targets
controls.find: match focus { None => true, Some(s) => s.contains(n) }
controls.replace: match focus { None => true, Some(s) => true }
controls.classification: effect: node_ids also loads the edge targets' triples (the repair for S6)

controls.name: rule-ignores-graph
controls.find: pub open spec fn min_ok_rule(r: Rows, g: G, n: N) -> bool { prop(r, g, n) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn min_ok_rule(r: Rows, g: G, n: N) -> bool { exists|h: G| #[trigger] prop(r, h, n) }
controls.classification: rule: graph-scope weakened to any graph

controls.name: class-ignores-label
controls.find: (loaded(focus, m) && exists|h2: G| #[trigger] lab(r, h2, m))
controls.classification: decision: sh:class accepts a loaded target without its label
